## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceTimelockRequired` — the action requires an executed governance proposal now that governance is bootstrapped.

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Route the gated action through `governance_propose` and execution after bootstrap; freezing stays immediate, but unfreezing requires a proposal.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#governance-timelock-integration-hook`](../../docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#governance-timelock-integration-hook)
